Our Story

A studio built on skilled hands & warm hospitality

BeautyHair Services was founded on a simple idea: every client deserves to feel seen, relaxed, and genuinely beautiful — not rushed through a chair. Our stylists and makeup artists train continuously in the latest cutting, coloring, and glam techniques, so whether you're in for a quick blowout or a full bridal package, the result is precise, personal, and unmistakably you.

We work with all hair types and skin tones, and we take real pride in getting undertones, textures, and finishes right the first time.

  • ✓ Certified, experienced stylists
  • ✓ Premium, skin-safe products
  • ✓ Bridal & event packages
  • ✓ Clean, relaxing studio space
